title: CallbackConfigResponse
description: Response body for the GET Callback Configuration endpoint. The HMAC secret is masked — only the last 6 characters are shown.

projectId.description: Project ID this callback configuration belongs to.

hmacSecretMask.description:
Masked representation of the HMAC secret. Only the last 6 characters are visible
(e.g. `••••••1b11ee`). To see the full secret, rotate it via
`POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/callbackConfig/rotate` or set a new one via `PATCH`.
